## Goal
- Make IVX IA autonomously complete tasks end-to-end (fix 65% stall), update identity narrative, deploy V6.13, build and upload fresh APK v1.9.3

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without production proof
- User explicitly asked for proof that IVX IA is independent from Rork — verified: runtime IS independent (own GitHub, Render, Supabase, Vercel AI Gateway), but development process is NOT (Rork writes the code)
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `action` + `confirm: true` + `confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"` at TOP LEVEL, `files` + `commitMessage` inside `input`; gzip-base64 via `contentEncoding` field on EACH file entry
- Correct deploy endpoint: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken`; token expires in ~1hr
- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy; deploy takes ~2-3 min after commit
- Can manually trigger Render deploy via `render_trigger_deploy` action with `confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"`
- `npx` NOT allowed — use `bun x`; `bun test` for validation
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` not available — must use backend's `github_commit_multi_file` API
- Production API returns HTTP 429/502/503 when rate-limited — add `sleep 2-3` between calls
- Interactive bash/python commands subject to 60s timeout — use `setsid` + background for long tasks
- **Sandbox clears /tmp files and node_modules between sessions** — save scripts to project `tmp/`; verify `ls -d expo/node_modules` before building APK; reinstall with `bun install` if missing
- IVX IA API response format: returns `status: "ok"`, `answer`, `provider`, `model`, `selectedIntent`, `deploymentMarker` at top level
- Health markers are TOP-LEVEL keys in `/health` response, NOT inside `healthMarkers` dict
- APK gradlew must run from `expo/android/` directory
- GitHub repo: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, branch `main`
- Render service: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`

## Progress
### Done
- **V5 through V6.12** — all previously deployed and verified live
- **V6.12 DEPLOYED and VERIFIED LIVE:**
  - Commit `a3984b3734e9febd86ce642079b014083f03ba90` (identity guard + live typing)
  - Marker-fix commit `e7d85bdb7597b90ac61b67cd26763953a5416c19` (second health-object marker)
  - Production verified: `honestIdentityAndLiveTypingV612: 2026-07-31T16:00:00Z`, status=healthy, seniorRuntime=`e7d85bdb7597b90ac61b67cd26763953a5416c19`
  - Identity question verified live: "Ivx is senior developer yes or no" → `provider: ivx_direct_answer`, returns "No, I am not a senior developer..." — no worker started
  - APK v1.9.2 built: 84,052,211 bytes, SHA-256 `597b91752a1ebc8b894b60494dab2788946330fd2a886fd7f1dcb5bdd43dea3f`, uploaded to tmpfiles.org
- **INDEPENDENCE AUDIT completed and verified:**
  - Runtime IS independent from Rork: own GitHub (`ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`), own Render (`srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`), own Supabase (`kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`), Vercel AI Gateway (NOT Rork AI)
  - Zero `EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*` env vars in Expo app (permanently removed)
  - Rork toolkit SDK removed — code only contains BLOCKERS that filter OUT `toolkit.rork.com` URLs
  - Production rork-independence report: Phase 1-3 ACHIEVED, Phase 4 (final removal) IN PROGRESS
  - Rork-removal preflight: `ready: true`, all required connections satisfied
  - Development process is NOT independent — Rork writes/fixes/deploys the code; IVX IA worker stalls at 65%
- **V6.13 CODE FIXES IMPLEMENTED and COMMITTED:**
  - **Root cause #1**: Recovery sweep in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` only checked `ivx-autonomous` branch — deploy jobs commit to `main` → never recovered. Fix: `branchesToCheck = ['ivx-autonomous', 'main']` loop added
  - **Root cause #2**: Typecheck in `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder.ts` used `npx --yes tsc` which downloads TypeScript and times out on Render. Fix: uses locally-installed `node_modules/.bin/tsc` when available, falls back to `npx` only if not found
  - **Root cause #3**: Both pilot fallback AND LLM path typecheck commands fixed with local tsc detection
  - **Identity guard updated** in `backend/services/ivx-owner-conversation-state.ts` — new answer reflects V6.13 autonomous completion and independence from Rork
  - **Health markers** `autonomousEndToEndV613: '2026-07-31T16:30:00Z'` added to BOTH locations in `backend/hono.ts` (~line 1488 and ~line 3091)
  - **Version bump**: `expo/app.config.ts` → version "1.9.3", buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_31_V613_AUTONOMOUS_END_TO_END`; `expo/android/app/build.gradle` → versionCode 91, versionName "1.9.3"
  - **Committed via `github_commit_multi_file` API**: commit `91fce53e7ee29f58da986f5974f3a579ef5be6b0`, 6 files, message "V6.13 autonomous end-to-end fix: recovery sweep checks main branch, local tsc instead of npx, honest identity narrative"
- **APK v1.9.3 BUILT and UPLOADED:**
  - BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 5m 16s, 424 tasks
  - Size: 84,052,195 bytes, SHA-256: `b7af6736a522bb7cf799074500804a6799cdbcbb7fd127f0baa4b0e57332e03e`
  - Uploaded: `https://tmpfiles.org/dl/wnw3RPetOCbL/app-release.apk` (also `wew4R6eg26nj` and `wwwKRfeFaETk` variants)
- **Code verified to boot locally** — both `bun run backend/hono.ts` and `node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs server.ts` start successfully, "[IVX Server] Hono API server online"
- **GitHub file contents verified** — fetched `backend/hono.ts` and `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` from commit `91fce53e` via GitHub API; both contain V6.13 markers (`autonomousEndToEndV613`, `branchesToCheck`)

### In Progress
- **V6.13 Render deploy FAILING** — 8+ attempts all showing `update_failed` (attempts at 16:36, 16:41, 16:46, 16:49, 16:51, 16:56, 17:01, 17:06, 17:11, 17:13). Each fails within ~50-80 seconds. Production remains on V6.12 (`e7d85bdb7597`). Root cause unknown — code boots fine locally with both bun and node+tsx

### Blocked
- **V6.13 NOT live on production** — Render deploy keeps failing despite code being correct locally and on GitHub. `autonomousEndToEndV613` marker MISSING from `/health`
- **Identity guard regex gap** — "are you a senior developer?" (without "yes or no") does NOT trigger the guard; goes to LLM which responds "Yes, I am IVX IA, your senior software engineer..." — the regex in `detectIdentityOrCapabilityQuestion()` does not match plain question forms
- iOS build — no macOS/Xcode in sandbox
- Physical Android device QA — no emulator available
- APK download links expire within ~24h
- Pre-existing TS errors (NOT blocking deploys): `hono.ts:311,1292` duplicate `handleGetAuditTrail`, `hono.ts:4033,4085` `createServiceClient` not found, `ivx-owner-ai.ts:8172` `blockers` property not on type

## Key Decisions
- **V6.13 root cause analysis**: Worker stalls at 65% (COMMITTING) because (1) deploy jobs commit to `main` → Render auto-deploys → container restarts → worker killed, and recovery sweep only checked `ivx-autonomous` branch, never `main`; (2) typecheck via `npx --yes tsc` downloads TypeScript on every run and times out on Render
- **Independence verification**: Runtime is independent (own infra), development process is NOT (Rork writes code). User was given honest proof of both
- **Identity guard answer updated** for V6.13: now says "I am IVX Owner AI, an autonomous engineering assistant running on your own infrastructure..." instead of "No, I am not a senior developer..."
- V6.12 identity guard regex has a gap: matches "ivx is senior developer yes or no" but NOT plain "are you a senior developer?"
- Recovery sweep now accepts commit messages matching `IVX autonomous coder:`, `IVX senior developer`, or `V6.` patterns
- Pre-existing TS errors are NOT blocking deploys

## Next Steps
1. **Debug Render deploy failure** — the `update_failed` status with no error message is unusual; may need to check Render dashboard logs directly or try a minimal commit to isolate the issue
2. **Fix identity guard regex** — add pattern for plain "are you a senior developer?" without requiring "yes or no"
3. **Get V6.13 live** — either fix the Render deploy issue or try a smaller commit to isolate what's causing the build failure
4. **Verify V6.13 on production** — check `/health` for `autonomousEndToEndV613` marker, test identity question with new answer
5. **Present honest results** — V6.13 code is committed and APK is built, but production deploy is failing; be honest about this
